thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem sync  let's pilot a lightweight remediation sprintlet process next month. goal: fewer dangling actions and clearer owner SLAs.
Leah: interested. can you outline the shortest possible timeline we can operate with? PMs hate long vague windows.
Sam: yes. here's a compact timeline I think will work for us:
```
T0 (incident): IC named, incident channel, brief outage note
T+12h: initial status + temp mitigations logged
T+24h: remediation owners assigned (owner must ack within 24h)
T+3BD: mitigation or documented workaround in place
T+14BD: remediation sprint complete or escalation to eng lead
T+28d: fix plan with acceptance criteria or showstopper review
Monthly: pattern review for recurring faults -> triage to systemic backlog
```
Priya: 24h ack is strict but reasonable. prefer 3 business days for mitigation to encourage small quick fixes first.
Evan: Will this be separate from the oncall duties? IC fatigue is a concern.
Sam: propose IC volunteer week from a cross-functional rotation (SRE, Platform, App). oncall stays focused on incident handling; IC owns follow-up coordination during their IC week.
Leah: we'll need an "IC starter pack" doc: short checklist + link to the board template.
IC-bot: pro tip: add `sprintlet:true` and `auto_ping:true` in the incident doc to trigger the template and reminders.
Priya: for action items, let's standardize a single-line format so the sync board can parse automatically. example: `ACTION: owner@example.com | short task title | SLA:24h/3BD/28d | ticket:#1234`
Sam: nice. that keeps things machine-readable. also let's require an owner email and a single SLA token. no nested items.
Evan: metrics question: what do we measure to decide success? closed-action % at T+3BD and T+14BD? time-to-ack? repeat incidents reduced?
Leah: closed-action % at 3BD and 14BD, mean time to remediation ack, and count of recurring incidents tagged as systemic.
OpsBot: logging: proposed_policy -> remediation_sprintlet_pilot by Sam @2245000123
Priya: rollout plan: pilot with incidents tagged P1/P2 for 6 weeks. collect baseline for those metrics, then evaluate.
Sam: next steps: I will open a short PR to /docs/incidents with the timeline, IC checklist, action item format, and the matrix for recurring issues. tagging @Leah to review PM copy. PR by EOD Friday.
Evan: I'll own the dashboard for metrics. will provide a weekly snapshot during the pilot.
Leah: small ask  include a tiny FAQ for PMs: what to expect, who to nag, and how to escalate. keep it one paragraph.
Sam: good call. will add. thanks everyone  excited to trial this.
